title: Analysis code and data: genetic liability to Crohn's disease, but not ulcerative colitis, is associated with increased risk of pyoderma gangrenosum (two-sample Mendelian randomization and integrated gut-skin transcriptomics)
description: Analysis code, input-data manifest and reproducible result tables for a Mendelian randomization (MR) and transcriptomics study of pyoderma gangrenosum (PG) and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The repository covers instrument selection and two-sample MR of IBD, Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC) against FinnGen R5/R12 PG; formal CD-UC contrast; two-step mediation through blood-cell traits and 32 immune-cell subsets; specificity analyses against six dermatological outcomes; integrated PG skin (GSE298908) and IBD gut (GSE75214) transcriptomics with seven pre-specified inflammatory programmes; independent validation in GSE280220 (NanoString nCounter, 5 PG versus 8 healthy skin); a transcriptome-anchored in silico ODE model with parameter-uncertainty and graded ablation; exploratory cis-pQTL drug-target MR with colocalization; and reproducibility outputs (ODE summary, full Enrichr tables, seed-fixed MR-PRESSO R5 output). Software requirements are listed in requirements.txt. Input datasets are public (OpenGWAS, GWAS Catalog, FinnGen, NCBI GEO) and itemised in data_manifest/input_data_manifest.csv. Version v1.1.0 adds the independent GSE280220 validation, the ODE/Enrichr/MR-PRESSO reproducibility outputs and the corresponding scripts and supplementary tables.
